atlas.prompt: Use case: background-extraction / original game props. Asset type: a transparent production sprite atlas for the user's original pharmacy academy RPG. Reference images show the EXACT existing art style and objects. Recreate isolated, high-detail cutout objects closely matching the wood, white tabletops, green/blue seats, glass and botanical materials in these references. Output ONE SQUARE image on a genuinely TRANSPARENT background, exactly 4 columns by 4 rows of equal square cells, one isolated object per cell, no visible grid, labels or floor. Every object must fit entirely inside its cell with 8% transparent padding; feet/base at about 90% of the cell height, centered horizontally. Match the elevated three-quarter/top-down camera used by the reference classrooms. Keep transparent holes between chair/table legs and realistic transparent glass. Row 1, left to right: (1) original honey-wood chair with sage-green padded seat and back, (2) original laboratory stool with curved wooden seat/back and steel wheeled base, (3) rounded blue padded study chair on white metal wheeled legs, (4) rounded sage gray padded study chair on white metal wheeled legs. Row 3: (9) clear glass conical laboratory flask, (10) clear tall graduated cylinder, (11) small amber glass specimen jar with glass lid, NO readable label, (12) white ceramic mortar with pestle.
